Ces nouvelles images satellites, mises en ligne en 2026 sur Google Maps, révèlent l’ampleur des destructions à Rafah, ville palestinienne de la bande de Gaza située à la frontière avec l’Égypte. Les routes restent partiellement visibles tandis que de vastes zones alentour apparaissent rasées. D’après l’analyse du Monde à partir d’images satellites, 630 hectares avaient déjà été rasés par l’armée israélienne avant le 17 mars 2025, notamment le long de la frontière égyptienne, dans le corridor de Philadelphie. Mais depuis le 17 mars 2025 et la rupture du cessez-le-feu, la destruction s’est encore amplifiée. Au 11 mai 2025, 68 % de la zone urbanisée de Rafah était anéantie selon Le Monde. Rafah était auparavant l’une des plus grandes villes de la bande de Gaza : 250 000 habitants avant la guerre. Les besoins de relèvement et de reconstruction de la bande de Gaza sont estimés à 71,5 milliards de dollars, selon le dernier rapport sur l’assistance de la CNUCED au peuple palestinien, présenté au Conseil du commerce et du développement des Nations Unies. Plus de 74 000 Palestiniens ont été tués et plus de 175 000 blessés depuis l'attaque menée par le Hamas contre Israël le 7 octobre 2023, d’après le dernier bilan du ministère de la Santé de Gaza. En Israël, plus de 1 000 civils ont été tués, selon l’Assurance nationale israélienne. Le ministère israélien de la Défense recense par ailleurs 1 152 membres des forces de sécurité morts depuis le 7 octobre 2023.  📸 - Google Earth : août 2023 / 2026

While children around the world return to school, Gaza’s children are entering their third consecutive year without an education. More than 90% of schools in Gaza have been damaged or reduced to ruins amid Israel’s unrelenting genocide. 22,000+ Palestinian children slaughtered. 44,000+ injured. Thousands remain missing. Likely martyred and still beneath the rubble. While children elsewhere put on new uniforms, carry new school bags and look forward to seeing their friends, children in Gaza are fighting simply to survive. Children are deliberately sniped as target practice and killed including for flying kites. Childhood stolen. Thousands orphaned. Children have been forced into the role of parents, caring for younger siblings after their parents martyred. The suffering doesn't stop at Gaza. In the West Bank, 84 Palestinian schools currently face demolition or orders to stop educating, leaving almost 13,000 students uncertain whether their schools will exist tomorrow. All of this unfolding against the backdrop of Israel’s continuing occupation and expansion of illegal settlements. For Palestinian children, school should mean learning, not survival. Childhood should mean safety, not fear. The children of Palestine have been deprived of their right to an education and the world has sadly failed to protect it. #freepalestine #stopthegenocide #palestine #gaza #westbank

Three years of genocide. 78 years of occupation. And it continues. For Palestinians, the genocide that began after October 7 never paused. There has been no ceasefire from hunger, deprivation, displacement, or grief. Only different forms of violence. Three grueling years of destroying homes, taking lives, and trying to erase hope. Children still wake up hungry. Elders long to return to their land. Young people cannot provide for their families. Babies die from malnutrition before they have a chance to live. And for three years, the world has watched. The Sameer Project provides food, water, medical care, shelter, and the support people need to keep going. To live with dignity. To hold onto hope. To build a future in their own homeland. Our work is rooted in Palestinian freedom and self-determination. Our people deserve to live long enough to see liberation. To see the occupation end. Keep showing up. Donate through the links in our bio. Help us turn your solidarity into the essentials our people need today - to sustain their hope for tomorrow.

Sad🇵🇸💔|| Palestine, officially known as the State of Palestine, is a country in the Middle East located along the eastern Mediterranean. It consists of the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, and the Gaza Strip. Palestine is a land of immense historical, cultural, and religious importance, with a history stretching back thousands of years. Palestine is home to some of the world’s most historically significant cities and sites. Jerusalem is one of the holiest cities in the world and is sacred to Muslims, Christians, and Jews. Bethlehem is traditionally regarded as the birthplace of Jesus Christ, while Jericho is among the world’s oldest continuously inhabited cities. Modern Palestinian national identity developed over many generations and became especially prominent during the 19th and 20th centuries. The Palestinian Declaration of Independence was proclaimed in 1988, and in 2012 the United Nations granted Palestine non-member observer State status. Today, most UN member states recognize the State of Palestine. Palestinian culture is rich in traditions including Arabic language and literature, tatreez embroidery, dabke dancing, olive cultivation, traditional cuisine, and strong family and community ties. Despite decades of conflict, displacement, and political division, Palestinians maintain a strong connection to their homeland and a distinct national identity. #palestine #israel #map #maps #fyp
